4.text:
<C:0001,0001,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0004,>～Volume 8～
[The Nightmare's Dream]<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>The Pi'illo attack continued unabated.
With the Zeekeeper's support, they
brought Antasma to bay.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>At Eldream's bidding, the beasts of
the forests rose up and they, too,
surrounded Antasma.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>So relentless was the assault that
Antasma clasped the Dark Stone
fast to his chest, muting its powers.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>From his vantage, Dreambert saw
this and knew the time had come.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>He would set his last, desperate
plan in motion and attempt to
seal Antasma away forever.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>If it succeeded, Antasma could
never cross the dream border.
Dream's Deep would be his prison.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Such was the course that 
Dreambert and Eldream had 
settled upon in their extremity.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>However, just as the portal to 
the world of dreams yawned open
and Antasma's doom was nigh...<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Something truly terrible happened.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,>Continued in Volume 9...
[The Final Struggle]<C:0003,0001,>

6.text:
<C:0001,0001,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0004,>～Volume 9～
[The Final Struggle]<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>Antasma was slowly swallowed by
the closing portal to the dream world,
and Dreambert sensed victory at hand.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>But it was not to be. Catastrophe
loomed, felt first by the creatures of
the forest that Eldream had called.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>They abandoned their circle of
containment around Antasma and began
a frantic retreat.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>Eldream noticed something was amiss.
He opened his mouth to cry out a
warning, but just at that moment...<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>A faint sneer appeared on the lips
of Antasma, hated and accursed.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Using all the terrible strength left
in his vile hands, the mage-king of
bats crushed the Dark Stone.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>His fell body had already been
swallowed by the void...<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Now, last of all, his fist slowly
disappeared, and Antasma was lost
to the depths of the dream world.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,>Continued in the final chapter...
[Dream without End]<C:0003,0001,>

8.text:
<C:0001,0001,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0004,>～The Final Chapter～
[Dream without End]<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>The portal to the dream world closed
on Antasma, and the Pi'illos seemed the
victors at last.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>But the Dark Stone had fragmented,
and now nightmare chunks fell from
the sky, shimmering in the darkness.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>The soft bodies of the Pi'illos began
hardening into stone, and one by one
they collapsed onto the grass.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Before long, neither victors nor the
fallen stood on the field of battle.
Only silence remained.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Who knows how much time has
passed since that dark day?<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>None know, but know this last:
When all movement on the plain had
ceased, a single rabbit appeared.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>It bounced like a stone in the surf
and then seemed to find a Pi'illo it
knew from among the fallen many.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Then, as if to protect the Pi'illo,
the rabbit lay against the stone,
closed its eyes, and slept.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>From then on, nothing marked the
passage of time on the island but
the silence of the stone Pi'illos.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,>～The End～
Continued in [Author's Postscript]<C:0003,0001,>
